Parameters.Name: pQuery
Parameters.Value: SELECT   location_group,   sku,     SAFE_DIVIDE(     SUM(location_sales_amount),     SUM(location_sales_quantity)   ) AS weighted_aur,    SAFE_DIVIDE(     SUM(location_sales_cogs),     SUM(location_sales_quantity)   ) AS weighted_auc,     SUM(location_sales_amount) AS location_sales_amount,   SUM(location_sales_quantity) AS location_sales_quantity,   SUM(location_sales_cogs) AS location_sales_cogs,   SUM(location_sales_margin) AS location_sales_margin,   SUM(location_on_order_quantity) AS location_on_order_quantity,   SUM(location_inventory_amount_ending) AS location_inventory_amount_ending,   SUM(location_inventory_amount_starting) AS location_inventory_amount_starting,   SUM(location_inventory_quantity_ending) AS location_inventory_quantity_ending,   SUM(location_inventory_quantity_starting) AS location_inventory_quantity_starting  FROM `merchplanning-suite-prod-062.planninganalytics.location_metrics_weekly` WHERE fiscal_week_end = DATE '2025-03-29' AND location_group <> 'null' GROUP BY   location_group,   sku ORDER BY   location_group,   sku ;
